meta.title: Night Raid
meta.description: In the dead of night, a grim visitor appears, surrounded by a dreadful air.

units.rawText: After the scenery around me crumbles, the memories return to my mind.
units.displayText: After the scenery around me crumbles, the memories return to my mind.

spans.text: After the scenery around me crumbles, the memories return to my mind.

units.rawText: 2:21 am, one day ago.
units.displayText: 2:21 am, one day ago.

spans.text: 2:21 am, one day ago.

units.rawText: In the Oasis' Medical Department.
units.displayText: In the Oasis' Medical Department.

spans.text: In the Oasis' Medical Department.

units.rawText: Sorry to call you here at this hour, Professor.
units.displayText: Sorry to call you here at this hour, Professor.

spans.text: Sorry to call you here at this hour, Professor.

units.rawText: Something tricky has come up all of a sudden... Please come with me.
units.displayText: Something tricky has come up all of a sudden... Please come with me.

spans.text: Something tricky has come up all of a sudden... Please come with me.

units.rawText: Area D66 of the Oasis was suddenly attacked 1 hour and 20 minutes ago.
units.displayText: Area D66 of the Oasis was suddenly attacked 1 hour and 20 minutes ago.

spans.text: Area D66 of the Oasis was suddenly attacked 1 hour and 20 minutes ago.

units.rawText: Isn't Area D66 under the protection of the Sandbox Barrier?
units.displayText: Isn't Area D66 under the protection of the Sandbox Barrier?

spans.text: Isn't Area D66 under the protection of the Sandbox Barrier?

units.rawText: Also, Antonina and Croque examined and repaired the Sandbox Barrier earlier today. Didn't they say there was nothing wrong with it?
units.displayText: Also, Antonina and Croque examined and repaired the Sandbox Barrier earlier today. Didn't they say there was nothing wrong with it?

spans.text: Also, Antonina and Croque examined and repaired the Sandbox Barrier earlier today. Didn't they say there was nothing wrong with it?

units.rawText: Yes, the Sandbox Barrier is indeed functioning normally.
units.displayText: Yes, the Sandbox Barrier is indeed functioning normally.

spans.text: Yes, the Sandbox Barrier is indeed functioning normally.

units.rawText: However, those monsters passed through it without any effort... That's never happened before.
units.displayText: However, those monsters passed through it without any effort... That's never happened before.

spans.text: However, those monsters passed through it without any effort... That's never happened before.
Monsters? Aren't the enemy Sanctifiers?
Are they very strong?

units.rawText: Frankly speaking, I don't know how to define them. They're scary black and purple creatures, and we can only describe them as "monsters."
units.displayText: Frankly speaking, I don't know how to define them. They're scary black and purple creatures, and we can only describe them as "monsters."

spans.text: Frankly speaking, I don't know how to define them. They're scary black and purple creatures, and we can only describe them as "monsters."

units.rawText: How shall I put this... They're ferocious, but that's not all.
units.displayText: How shall I put this... They're ferocious, but that's not all.

spans.text: How shall I put this... They're ferocious, but that's not all.

units.rawText: Our defense units managed to defeat them after a tough fight, but...
units.displayText: Our defense units managed to defeat them after a tough fight, but...

spans.text: Our defense units managed to defeat them after a tough fight, but...

units.rawText: Persicaria brings a clip of combat footage up on her portable terminal.
units.displayText: Persicaria brings a clip of combat footage up on her portable terminal.

spans.text: Persicaria brings a clip of combat footage up on her portable terminal.

units.rawText: This is combat footage from when our frontline fighters realized something was wrong.
units.displayText: This is combat footage from when our frontline fighters realized something was wrong.

spans.text: This is combat footage from when our frontline fighters realized something was wrong.

units.rawText: Someone's passed out here!
units.displayText: Someone's passed out here!

spans.text: Someone's passed out here!

units.rawText: No problem, we've got this side under control! Hurry and bring the wounded...
units.displayText: No problem, we've got this side under control! Hurry and bring the wounded...

spans.text: No problem, we've got this side under control! Hurry and bring the wounded...

units.rawText: Urgh!
units.displayText: Urgh!

spans.text: Urgh!

units.rawText: A purplish-black monster suddenly appears out of nowhere and lunges at the agent. Its writhing tentacle-tips create a deep wound in the agent's waist. The agent collapses with a cry.
units.displayText: A purplish-black monster suddenly appears out of nowhere and lunges at the agent. Its writhing tentacle-tips create a deep wound in the agent's waist. The agent collapses with a cry.

spans.text: A purplish-black monster suddenly appears out of nowhere and lunges at the agent. Its writhing tentacle-tips create a deep wound in the agent's waist. The agent collapses with a cry.

units.rawText: Thud—
units.displayText: Thud—

spans.text: Thud—

units.rawText: Hey!
units.displayText: Hey!

spans.text: Hey!

units.rawText: Medic! Medic!!
units.displayText: Medic! Medic!!

spans.text: Medic! Medic!!

units.rawText: The shaky camera points toward the unconscious agent. Terrifying black-and-purple veins spread from the wound and the agent's face contorts in pain.
units.displayText: The shaky camera points toward the unconscious agent. Terrifying black-and-purple veins spread from the wound and the agent's face contorts in pain.

spans.text: The shaky camera points toward the unconscious agent. Terrifying black-and-purple veins spread from the wound and the agent's face contorts in pain.

units.rawText: Her neural cloud's firewall is falling apart!
units.displayText: Her neural cloud's firewall is falling apart!

spans.text: Her neural cloud's firewall is falling apart!

units.rawText: She's been infected! Stay away from her and avoid making contact with the wound!
units.displayText: She's been infected! Stay away from her and avoid making contact with the wound!

spans.text: She's been infected! Stay away from her and avoid making contact with the wound!

units.rawText: The medical agent quickly summons operands into her hands and produces a thick, spherical barrier around the unconscious agent.
units.displayText: The medical agent quickly summons operands into her hands and produces a thick, spherical barrier around the unconscious agent.

spans.text: The medical agent quickly summons operands into her hands and produces a thick, spherical barrier around the unconscious agent.

units.rawText: Cover me! I need to take her back for treatment!
units.displayText: Cover me! I need to take her back for treatment!

spans.text: Cover me! I need to take her back for treatment!

units.rawText: Too many people are down! We won't be able to hold the monsters back like this!
units.displayText: Too many people are down! We won't be able to hold the monsters back like this!

spans.text: Too many people are down! We won't be able to hold the monsters back like this!

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: The agent's cry could not help the person filming the scene avoid the black and purple monster in time.
units.displayText: The agent's cry could not help the person filming the scene avoid the black and purple monster in time.

spans.text: The agent's cry could not help the person filming the scene avoid the black and purple monster in time.

units.displayText: The footage suddenly ends and Persicaria puts her portable terminal away.

spans.text: The footage suddenly ends and Persicaria puts her portable terminal away.

units.rawText: We're here, Professor.
units.displayText: We're here, Professor.

spans.text: We're here, Professor.

units.rawText: After pushing open the door to the observation ward, I see rows upon rows of unconscious agents surrounded by spherical barriers, occasionally groaning in pain.
units.displayText: After pushing open the door to the observation ward, I see rows upon rows of unconscious agents surrounded by spherical barriers, occasionally groaning in pain.

spans.text: After pushing open the door to the observation ward, I see rows upon rows of unconscious agents surrounded by spherical barriers, occasionally groaning in pain.

units.rawText: Many agents go back and forth. Whispered conversations fill the air and the mood is grim.
units.displayText: Many agents go back and forth. Whispered conversations fill the air and the mood is grim.

spans.text: Many agents go back and forth. Whispered conversations fill the air and the mood is grim.

units.rawText: The monsters who attacked us seem to be carrying a very special electronic virus. Agents affected by it fall into a coma and can't be woken up.
units.displayText: The monsters who attacked us seem to be carrying a very special electronic virus. Agents affected by it fall into a coma and can't be woken up.

spans.text: The monsters who attacked us seem to be carrying a very special electronic virus. Agents affected by it fall into a coma and can't be woken up.

units.rawText: A coma?
units.displayText: A coma?

spans.text: A coma?

units.rawText: Correct. Their neural clouds can't sustain normal operations because of the viral infection, so we can't wake them up by normal means either.
units.displayText: Correct. Their neural clouds can't sustain normal operations because of the viral infection, so we can't wake them up by normal means either.

spans.text: Correct. Their neural clouds can't sustain normal operations because of the viral infection, so we can't wake them up by normal means either.

units.rawText: Since the virus breaks down the firewalls for Doll neural clouds, Antonina has been working on reconfiguring individual firewalls to resist the virus.
units.displayText: Since the virus breaks down the firewalls for Doll neural clouds, Antonina has been working on reconfiguring individual firewalls to resist the virus.

spans.text: Since the virus breaks down the firewalls for Doll neural clouds, Antonina has been working on reconfiguring individual firewalls to resist the virus.

units.rawText: She's in there now.
units.displayText: She's in there now.

spans.text: She's in there now.

units.rawText: Send me a copy of the neural cloud observation logs for agents 31 to 40.
units.displayText: Send me a copy of the neural cloud observation logs for agents 31 to 40.

spans.text: Send me a copy of the neural cloud observation logs for agents 31 to 40.

units.rawText: How are things, Antonina?
units.displayText: How are things, Antonina?

spans.text: How are things, Antonina?

units.rawText: Oh, you're here?
units.displayText: Oh, you're here?

spans.text: Oh, you're here?

units.rawText: The analysis will be ready soon, give me a bit.
units.displayText: The analysis will be ready soon, give me a bit.

spans.text: The analysis will be ready soon, give me a bit.

units.displayText: Antonina's fingers fly over her mobile terminal.

spans.text: Antonina's fingers fly over her mobile terminal.

units.rawText: ...The situation does not look good at all.
units.displayText: ...The situation does not look good at all.

spans.text: ...The situation does not look good at all.

units.rawText: This is a brand new type of electronic virus, with a certain degree of intelligence and extreme adaptability.
units.displayText: This is a brand new type of electronic virus, with a certain degree of intelligence and extreme adaptability.

spans.text: This is a brand new type of electronic virus, with a certain degree of intelligence and extreme adaptability.

units.rawText: It evolves in response to the target it infects, so there are as many variants as there are victims.
units.displayText: It evolves in response to the target it infects, so there are as many variants as there are victims.

spans.text: It evolves in response to the target it infects, so there are as many variants as there are victims.

units.rawText: Worst of all, it's still evolving independently, so we have no way to directly analyze it. I need to analyze the virus from its source.
units.displayText: Worst of all, it's still evolving independently, so we have no way to directly analyze it. I need to analyze the virus from its source.

spans.text: Worst of all, it's still evolving independently, so we have no way to directly analyze it. I need to analyze the virus from its source.

units.rawText: There is no source.
units.displayText: There is no source.

spans.text: There is no source.

units.rawText: You're...
units.displayText: You're...

spans.text: You're...

units.rawText: A survivor from the garrison of Area D66.
units.displayText: A survivor from the garrison of Area D66.

spans.text: A survivor from the garrison of Area D66.

units.rawText: We wiped out all those monsters and left none alive. I checked the team logs; back then they just treated it as an ordinary virus incursion.
units.displayText: We wiped out all those monsters and left none alive. I checked the team logs; back then they just treated it as an ordinary virus incursion.

units.displayText: ...Urgh!

spans.text: ...Urgh!

units.displayText: It's No. 27! Medic! Medic! I need Agent No. 27's code status!

units.displayText: A medical agent heads over to Agent No. 27's side.

units.rawText: That's the region used for the most basic neural cloud operations, where the core data is stored. If it's in the Tertiary Layer, then that means...

units.rawText: Is this the second stage of the infection...? Dammit!
units.displayText: Is this the second stage of the infection...? Dammit!

spans.text: Is this the second stage of the infection...? Dammit!

units.rawText: She's probably in something like a dream world now, so there won't be any pain for the time being.
units.displayText: She's probably in something like a dream world now, so there won't be any pain for the time being.

units.rawText: But if the virus invades her Tertiary Layer, her consciousness will be lost forever and she can't even be reset.
units.displayText: But if the virus invades her Tertiary Layer, her consciousness will be lost forever and she can't even be reset.

spans.text: But if the virus invades her Tertiary Layer, her consciousness will be lost forever and she can't even be reset.

units.displayText: We need to restore her neural cloud firewalls ASAP. Antonina!

units.displayText: Give me some time... I need time!

57.name: Tertiary Level
57.description:
Also known as Level III, it is the space where a Doll's base codes and core data are stored.
 If a Doll's consciousness sinks to this Tertiary Level, their neural cloud is no longer capable of performing anything other than the most basic computation.
